name: 12-Week Squad Squat Peak
description: A 12-week three-phase squat program focused on building a volume foundation, transitioning to heavy triples, and peaking for a true 1RM.

exercises.notes: Full squat depth, explosive drive through the ball.
Add 2.5 kg from last week if possible.
Full squat depth, explosive drive through the ball.
Work up to a 5-rep max (5RM) to test strength at the end of the Volume Block. Do not go to complete failure.
5x3 @ 78%. Welcome to strength block. Big belt, big bracing.
Upper back work for squat stability.
5x2 @ 85%. Heavy doubles. Full rest between sets.
6 per leg. Last heavy single-leg work.
Work up to a heavy 3-rep max (3RM) to test strength before moving into the peaking phase.
3x2 @ 88%. Peaking block begins. Focus on commands and walkout.
3x3 @ 72%. Speed and technique. Move the bar fast.
3x1 @ 92%. Heavy singles. Full rest. Nail your walkout.
3x2 @ 72%. Speed work. Explosive out of the hole.
2x1 @ 95%. Opener practice. This should feel heavy but confident.
3x3 @ 60%. Light taper session. Fast and perfect reps.
Work up to a new 1RM. Warm up: bar → 50% → 60% → 70% → 80% → 90% → attempt.
2x3 @ 75% of new max. Celebrate, program complete!

name: 8-Week Beginner Squat Foundation
description: A beginner-friendly 8-week squat program focused on building proper technique, confidence, and a strength foundation.

phases.name: Block 1: Technique & Foundation
phases.goal: Master proper squat form and build base strength.

phases.name: Block 2: Strength Building
phases.goal: Apply progressive overload with learned technique.

exercises.notes: 3x12. Focus on depth and upright torso.
Light weight, focus on sitting back.
Light weight, feel the hamstring stretch.
Add small weight. Focus on power off the box.
3x8 @ 62%. Form check - film yourself if possible.
Work up to a 5RM to establish training max. This is your baseline test.
3x8 @ 65%. Using new training max from Week 4.
Focus on sitting back and driving up.
3x6 @ 70%. Heavy triples - approach but don't hit failure.
Work up to a new 1RM. Warm up: bar → 50% → 60% → 70% → 80% → 90% → attempt. You've built the foundation - time to test it!
2x3 @ 75% of new max. Celebrate - program complete!
